limits: Finite importance overlap cannot establish unseen-mode coverage. Poor H0 overlap requires dedicated anchored sampling, not clipped weights or relaxed gates. This target retains the released ladder/SN selection and calibration assumptions, physical CAMB domain and existing approximate cross-probe factorization; it does not infer cross-covariance or a progenitor-age correction.
normalization: Use the frozen ReleasedCalibration interface and complete1657-row selected covariance, with77calibrator and1580noncalibrator rows. Retain its explicit printed-covariance symmetrization and flat-M determinant/normalization. Do not add H0, Cepheid, geometric-anchor or overlapping SN factors. No evidence ratio is defined under the improper flat-M measure.
comparison: Paired conditional mean shifts, not independent-fit significances. Dovekie is replaced, not multiplied by an H0 factor.
status_of_failed_weight_summaries: Diagnostics only, never an admitted measurement.
